name: zodiacs-developer
description: Build and verify astrology integrations with the published Zodiacs engine, bounded sky tools and local chart comparison.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Zodiacs LLC, the operator of Zodiacs.org. Build Moon widgets, sky calendars and astrology APIs with the published Zodiacs engine. Verify calculation records and test timezones with synthetic inputs. The local developer server supports natal calculations without a listener or outbound connection; the assistant provider can still receive inputs and results. Chart Studio includes placement inspection, house comparison, UTC time exploration and calculation-record inspection. Explore a possible birth-time window without choosing a birth time. Imported records stay in the panel; they can be compared or recalculated with the installed engine. Sharing a selection with the assistant requires a review and explicit action. Public directory availability is not offered by this review candidate.

Official website: https://zodiacs.org/ . Company and contact: https://zodiacs.org/about/ . Support: admin@zodiacs.org . Methods and developer documentation: https://zodiacs.org/developers/ . Privacy and terms are linked in this profile.
